note: Iron County MI publishes no queryable zoning polygon service. Iron River's zoning map is a PNG download, Crystal Falls' zoning map is a PDF, and township zoning maps (Mastodon, Crystal Falls Twp, Stambaugh, Mansfield) are PDFs. The county GIS viewer (Colligo) is a login-gated desktop app with no zoning layer found; ArcGIS Online searches turned up no Iron County zoning service.
